messages.subject: Potential Job: EcoHealth Alliance
messages.body_plain:
Hey folks,

A request for applicants for a great job with EcoHealth Alliance...passed along from the original founder of the Davis R Users Group, Noam Ross. Job involves lots of #rstats and modeling for COVID-19 response/advisory purposes.

Posting is here:
https://www.ecohealthalliance.org/career/research-data-scientist-covid-19-response-analysis
And you can find the thread on twitter here if you are interested (a few other jobs listed as well):
https://twitter.com/noamross/status/1324061816427864065

R

messages.subject: Mapping in R Workshop (#maptimeDavis & D-RUG): Tues 11/24 from 10am-12pm
messages.subject_clean: Mapping in R Workshop (#maptimeDavis & D-RUG): Tues 11/24 from 10am-12pm
messages.body_plain:
Hi R-folks!

Hope everyone is being kind to themselves and others these days. Just wanted to let folks know D-RUG & #maptimeDavis are hosting/teaching a short workshop next week: "From Spatial Data to Publication Ready Figure: Mapmaking with R <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/maptimedavis-workshop-mapping-with-r/>" (Tues 11/24, from 10am-12pm).

It's free and open to any who are interested. We'll be hosting over zoom (see the link above for info). This is aimed at folks who are interested in making maps in R, or working with vector-based spatial data, but haven't made the leap yet. Hopefully we can show you a few cool tricks and tips you haven't seen before.

Please join us if you can!

Thanks,
-R

--

messages.subject: #maptimeDavis + D-RUG Workshop: Mapping with R
messages.body_plain:
#maptimeDavis Workshop is  excited to present a crossover event with the Davis R Users Group: “From Spatial Data to Publication Ready Figure: Mapmaking with R” with instructor Ryan Peek, Tuesday, Nov. 24th from 10:00-12:00 via Zoom!   Register <https://registration.genomecenter.ucdavis.edu/events/mtdmappingr/> for this event.

People of all levels of skill and experience are welcome! If you plan to follow along, introductory understanding of R will be helpful and please have R and R Studio installed on your computer.

We will meet on Tuesday, Nov. 24th from 10:00-12:00 via Zoom.  For more details and zoom link, see the Spatial Sciences Research & Learning Cluster <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/spatial-sciences/> page.  Please send questions to Michele Tobias – mmto...@ucdavis.edu

*** Upcoming #maptimeDavis Workshops & Studios ***

***             Tuesdays, 10:00-12:00 via Zoom                  ***

Date      Topic     Speaker

24-Nov  #maptimeDavis & Davis R Users Group Workshop:  From Spatial Data to Publication Ready Figure: Mapmaking with R <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/maptimedavis-workshop-mapping-with-r/>              Ryan Peek

1-Dec    #maptimeDavis Studio:  Mapping with R <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/maptimedavis-studio-mapping-with-r/> Community Discussion

Registration for workshops you plan to attend is highly encouraged but not required.  Please do not sign up for things you don’t plan to attend.  Whenever possible, the workshops will be recorded and posted on the DataLab YouTube channel <https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCTooXK1RiSHNbWsmeqz0W6g>.  Studio will not be recorded to encourage open discussion.  Weekly reminders will be sent on the Geospatial Email List <https://lists.ucdavis.edu/sympa/info/geospatial>.

#maptimeDavis <https://github.com/maptimedavis/MaptimeDavis> Workshops and Studio are a product of UC Davis DataLab <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/>’s  Spatial Sciences Research Cluster <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/spatial-sciences/> and are supported by the contributions and participation of our community.  Please send questions to Michele Tobias mmto...@ucdavis.edu

Michele Tobias, PhD

Geospatial Data Specialist
